Create one 2-column by 2-row atlas from the supplied reference grid only. The reference is a 2x2 grid of repeated native 64x35 upper portrait halves, each enlarged 8x with nearest-neighbor pixel edges. Same character, guarded/skeptical emotion. Make expression subtly but clearly skeptical through asymmetry: raise the viewer-left brow gently, keep viewer-right brow relaxed and close to its source position. Do not lower both inner brows, form an angry V, or make both brows sharply arched. Keep complete natural brow tips and soft brown brow color. Keep brows and stationary orbital creases consistent in all four cells. Preserve subdued tan/brown skin, olive-brown eye shadows, gray-violet iris color and exact original iris width, spacing, pupil direction, pupil position and glint positions. Use restrained pixel-art shading with soft contrast; no orange skin, no white eye flashes, no harsh black brows, no smooth vector edges.

Change only expression around the eyes. Keep face, nose, hair, cheek, background, framing and every unrelated source feature aligned with reference. Eye animation preserves iris width and horizontal position. Half-closed lid covers the eye vertically from above; do not move glint, shrink or round iris, shift gaze, or cross lower lid. Fully closed cell conceals iris and sclera completely. Retain guarded asymmetry during blink. Repeated open cell should match first open cell. Keep a true native pixel grid after 8x enlargement.
